name: Getac UX10-EX G2-R
statusNote: Getac now lists the G5 generation in its place; it published no end-of-sale date.
summary: The Getac UX10-EX G2-R is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 10.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 Pro. It has been discontinued; the Getac UX10-EX G5 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current (both), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not published

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)
certification.ambient: Depends on certificate: EPS 19.0082X issue 3 = −21 to +63 °C (IIIB)

safety.conditions: As UX10-Exc: protect from UV and mechanical impact; interfaces never used in hazardous areas; battery never changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas; not next to strong charge-generating processes; batteries BP3S2P2100S-01 / BP3S3P3450P-03.
safety.peripherals: All connection interfaces (USB, Thunderbolt, DC-in, docking connector, LAN, serial) must never be used in hazardous areas (certificate condition). Optional internal modules named in the certificate are covered as part of the certified tablet.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the certificates: hand strap, shoulder strap, shoulder harness, capacitive stylus and tether, digitizer pen and tether. Chargers, AC adapters and DS100 dock are for non-hazardous areas only (accessory brochure).

os.name: Windows
os.updates: Windows 11: supported while kept on a current version (Microsoft Modern Lifecycle)

specs.chip: Intel Core i5-10210U / i5-10310U vPro / i7-10510U / i7-10610U vPro (10th gen)
specs.frontCamera: FHD webcam or optional Windows Hello camera
specs.ports: USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A, HDMI 1.4, DC-in; top slot options: barcode, USB, RJ45, VGA, HF RFID

unconfirmed.certification.iecex.number: Getac's certificate names the model with a 'c' suffix and doesn't name the generation. We matched it to this generation by its batteries, dust group and ambient range.
